_comment: Narrator registry shared by every Memory Map section (system map, journeys, canon). One narrator can have several recordings (part 1, 2...). excluded_segments are spans the narrator asked to have cut (or said in confidence); claims inside them are dropped. regions and joined/cohort are editorial and drive the filters; edit them by hand. cohort is derived from joined (before 1980 / 1980s / 1990s or later / unknown) when the model is built.
